produced_by.game: Kakutou Ryouri Densetsu Bistro Recipe - Kettou Bistgarm Hen (Game Boy Color)
produced_by.notes:
**Kakutou Ryouri Densetsu Bistro Recipe - Kettou Bistgarm Hen** is Banpresto's 1999 Game Boy Color game (also playable on the original Game Boy) based on the anime *Kakutou Ryouri Densetsu Bistro Recipe*, released only in Japan. It is the sequel of *Gekitou Foodon Battle Hen*: Zen has freed his father Tsukiji from the mask of Crown, and now he must storm Bistgarm, the island fortress of Don Cook and his Bishokker, beat the Big Four in their tower, free the captured Bistras and find out what Don Cook is planning. Cook dishes, turn them into fighting Foodons, battle rival Bistras, learn their recipes, try the casino and the minigames of Yatai Land, and use Pitan's new Topping Studies.

This translation keeps the **original Japanese names** (Zen, Karin, Pitan, Haoji, Tsukiji, Bishokker, Foodon names romanized from the Japanese puns), not the names of the US dub *Fighting Foodons*, and it uses the same names and terms as the English translation of *Gekitou Foodon Battle Hen*.

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play. It must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like): it isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.
